pve:proxmox:CPU.description: CPU configuration for the virtual machine.

cores.description: Number of CPU cores per socket.

flagsDisabled.description: List of CPU flags to disable.

flagsEnabled.description: List of CPU flags to enable (e.g., pcid, spec-ctrl).

hidden.description: Hide VM CPU type from the guest operating system.

hvVendorId.description: Hyper-V vendor ID presented to the guest (up to 12 characters).

limit.description: CPU usage limit as a fraction of one core (e.g., 1.5 caps at 150%).

physBits.description: Number of physical address bits exposed to the guest (e.g., 36, 40, 48).

units.description: CPU weight for the scheduler relative to other VMs (higher = more CPU time).

vcpus.description: Number of hotplugged vCPUs (must be <= cores * sockets).

pve:proxmox:Clone.description: Configuration for cloning a source virtual machine.

dataStoreId.description: Target storage pool for the cloned disks.

fullClone.description: Create a full independent clone instead of a linked clone.

node.description: Target Proxmox node for the clone operation.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for the clone operation.

vmId.description: Source VM ID to clone from.

pve:proxmox:Disk.description: Disk configuration for the virtual machine.

aio.description: Asynchronous I/O mode: native, threads, or io_uring. Omit to use the Proxmox default.

backup.description: Include this disk in Proxmox backups. Defaults to true when omitted; set to false to exclude the disk from backups.

bandwidth.description: I/O throttle limits for this disk (Proxmox GUI 'Bandwidth' section). Omit to apply no throttling.

cache.description: Cache mode for the disk: none, writethrough, writeback, unsafe, or directsync. Omit to use the Proxmox default (no explicit cache setting).

discard.description: Discard/TRIM support: ignore (default) or on. Enable for thin-provisioned storage and SSDs to reclaim freed blocks.

filename.description: File name of the disk image (computed by Proxmox if not provided).

format.description: Disk image format: raw, qcow2, vmdk, etc. Relevant primarily for file-based storage (local, NFS); block-based storage (LVM, Ceph) ignores this field and may not return it on read. Changing the format of an existing disk is not supported by Proxmox.

interface.description: Disk interface type and slot (e.g., scsi0, virtio0, ide1, sata2). Changing this field on an existing disk (same map key) moves the volume to the new slot using the Proxmox move_disk API — the volume and its data are preserved. Moves within the same bus family are supported (e.g., scsi0 → scsi1). Cross-bus moves (e.g., scsi0 → sata0) are rejected at preview time because they would recreate the volume. The map key (not this field) is the primary disk identity: renaming the map key deletes the old disk.

iothread.description: Enable a dedicated I/O thread for this disk. Only supported on scsi and virtio interfaces.

media.description: Media type: 'disk' (default) or 'cdrom'. Supported on all disk interfaces.

queues.description: Number of I/O queues for this disk. Only supported on scsi and virtio interfaces. Minimum value is 2 (enforced by Proxmox); there is no enforced upper bound.

replicate.description: Include this disk in Proxmox storage replication. Defaults to true when omitted; set to false to exclude the disk from replication.

rerror.description: Action on read I/O errors: 'ignore', 'report', or 'stop'. Proxmox default is 'report'. Supported on all disk interfaces.

ro.description: Mount this disk as read-only inside the guest. Only supported on scsi and virtio interfaces.

scsiblock.description: Use the scsi-block I/O path instead of virtio-scsi. Only supported on scsi interfaces. May improve performance for some workloads.

serial.description: Serial number string exposed to the guest OS. Up to 60 characters; alphanumeric characters, hyphens, underscores, and dots are accepted. Commas and equals signs are rejected by Proxmox. Validated and enforced by the provider.

shared.description: Mark this disk as shared across cluster nodes. Required for live migration with local storage.

snapshot.description: Disk is part of a Proxmox snapshot chain. This field is normally managed by Proxmox and should not be set manually.

ssd.description: Emulate a solid-state drive for the guest OS (affects rotation rate hints). Supported on ide, sata, and scsi interfaces; not valid for virtio.

storage.description: Target storage pool for the disk (e.g., local-lvm, ceph-pool).

werror.description: Action on write I/O errors: 'enospc', 'ignore', 'report', or 'stop'. Proxmox default is 'enospc'. Supported on all disk interfaces.

wwn.description: World Wide Name (unique disk identifier). Must be exactly 16 lowercase hex digits prefixed with '0x', e.g. 0x500a0000deadbeef. Proxmox enforces the format with a regex; invalid values are rejected at apply time.

pve:proxmox:DiskBandwidth.description: I/O throttle limits for the disk

iopsRd.description: Read I/O operations per second limit (0 = unlimited).

iopsRdMax.description: Read burst I/O operations per second limit.

iopsWr.description: Write I/O operations per second limit (0 = unlimited).

iopsWrMax.description: Write burst I/O operations per second limit.

mbpsRd.description: Read throughput limit in MB/s (0 = unlimited).

mbpsRdMax.description: Read burst throughput limit in MB/s; allows temporary bursts above MBpsRd.

mbpsWr.description: Write throughput limit in MB/s (0 = unlimited).

mbpsWrMax.description: Write burst throughput limit in MB/s; allows temporary bursts above MBpsWr.

pve:proxmox:EfiDisk.description: EFI disk configuration for the virtual machine.

efitype.description: EFI firmware size: '2m' (2 MB, legacy) or '4m' (4 MB, supports Secure Boot).

filename.description: File name of the EFI disk image (computed by Proxmox if not provided).

preEnrolledKeys.description: Pre-enroll Microsoft and standard UEFI keys into the EFI firmware.

storage.description: Target storage pool for the EFI disk (e.g., local-lvm).

pve:proxmox:NumaNode.description: NUMA node topology configuration for the virtual machine.

cpus.description: CPUs (and optionally threads) assigned to this NUMA node (e.g., 0-3).

hostNodes.description: Host NUMA nodes to map to this virtual NUMA node (e.g., 0-1).

memory.description: Memory in megabytes allocated to this NUMA node.

policy.description: NUMA memory allocation policy (preferred, bind, interleave, or mpol).

ugid.description: The user, group, or token ID associated with the ACL.

roleid.description: The role ID of the ACL.

pve:file:File.description: A Proxmox file resource that represents a file in a Proxmox datastore.

contentType.description: The type of the file (e.g: snippets)

datastoreId.description: The datastore to upload the file to.  (e.g:ceph-ha)

contentType.description: The type of the file (e.g: snippets)

pve:group:Group.description: A Proxmox group resource that represents a group in the Proxmox VE.

comment.description: An optional comment for the group. If not provided, defaults to 'Default group comment'.

name.description: The name of the Proxmox group.

pve:ha:HA.description: A Proxmox HA resource that manages the HA configuration of a virtual machine in the Proxmox VE.

resourceId.description: The ID of the virtual machine that will be managed by HA (required).

state.description: The state of the HA resource (default: started).

resourceId.description: The ID of the virtual machine that will be managed by HA (required).

pve:pool:Pool.description: A Proxmox pool resource that groups virtual machines under a common pool in the Proxmox VE.

comment.description: An optional comment for the pool

name.description: The name of the Proxmox pool.

storage.description: An optional list of storage names to assign to the pool.

vms.description: An optional list of VM IDs to assign to the pool.

comment.description: An optional comment for the pool

name.description: The name of the Proxmox pool.

storage.description: An optional list of storage names to assign to the pool.

vms.description: An optional list of VM IDs to assign to the pool.

pve:role:Role.description: A Proxmox role resource that represents a role in the Proxmox VE.

name.description: The name of the Proxmox role.

privileges.description: A list of privileges assigned to this role. Each privilege should be a string identifier (e.g., 'VM.PowerMgmt').

name.description: The name of the Proxmox role.

privileges.description: A list of privileges assigned to this role. Each privilege should be a string identifier (e.g., 'VM.PowerMgmt').

pve:sdn/zone:VxlanZone.description: A Proxmox SDN VXLAN zone resource managed via /cluster/sdn/zones.

dns.description: DNS plugin ID associated with this zone.

dnsZone.description: DNS zone/domain name used for host registrations.

fabric.description: SDN fabric identifier used to connect this VXLAN zone to an EVPN fabric.

ipam.description: IPAM plugin ID associated with this zone.

mtu.description: MTU for the VXLAN zone. If unset, Proxmox uses its automatic/default MTU.

nodes.description: Cluster nodes where this zone is active.

peers.description: A list of peer IP addresses in the VXLAN underlay network. Note: peers are not returned by the Proxmox API on read and will not be refreshed by `pulumi refresh`.

reverseDns.description: Reverse DNS plugin ID associated with this zone.

vxlanPort.description: UDP destination port used for VXLAN encapsulation.

pve:sdn:Apply.description: Applies pending SDN configuration changes in Proxmox VE via PUT /cluster/sdn. Re-runs whenever any trigger value changes.

applyTimeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for the SDN apply task to complete, in seconds. Defaults to 60.

lockTimeoutSeconds.description: How long to keep retrying SDN lock acquisition before failing, in seconds. Defaults to 60.

triggers.description: Arbitrary key-value pairs that can include resource outputs or complex objects. When any trigger value changes, the SDN apply is re-executed.

applyTimeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for the SDN apply task to complete, in seconds. Defaults to 60.

lockTimeoutSeconds.description: How long to keep retrying SDN lock acquisition before failing, in seconds. Defaults to 60.

pve:sdn:Vnet.description: A Proxmox SDN VNet resource that defines a per-zone virtual network materialized as a bridge on each node after SdnApply runs.

alias.description: An optional descriptive alias for the VNet.

digest.description: Read-only digest of the VNet configuration section, used by Proxmox for change detection.

isolatePorts.description: If true, sets the isolated property for all interfaces on the bridge of this VNet.

state.description: Read-only pending-apply state of the VNet ("new", "changed", or "deleted"); empty once the config has been applied.

tag.description: The unique VNI/VLAN tag for this VNet (convention: 10000 + pool number).

vlanaware.description: If true, allow guest VLANs to pass through (trunk) this VNet.

vnet.description: The VNet identifier/name (max 8 alphanumeric characters). This is the bridge name VMs reference.

zone.description: The SDN zone this VNet belongs to (e.g. "ringfence").

pve:user:User.description: A Proxmox user resource that represents a user in the Proxmox VE.

comment.description: An optional comment for the user.

email.description: An optional email address for the user.

enable.description: Whether the user is enabled. Defaults to true.

expire.description: The expiration time for the user as a Unix timestamp.

firstname.description: The first name of the user.

groups.description: A list of groups the user belongs to.

keys.description: A list of SSH keys associated with the user.

lastname.description: The last name of the user.

password.description: The password for the user. This field is treated as a secret.

userid.description: The user ID of the Proxmox user, including the realm (e.g., 'user@pve').

autostart.description: Automatically start the VM when the host boots (1 to enable, 0 to disable).

balloon.description: Minimum memory for ballooning in megabytes (0 disables the balloon device).

clone.description: Clone configuration for creating the VM from a source template or VM.

cpu.description: CPU configuration including type, topology, and feature flags.

description.description: Description or notes for the virtual machine.

disks.description: Map of disk configurations keyed by a stable logical name (e.g. "database", "logs"). The map key is the primary disk identity: renaming a key removes the old disk and creates a new one. Each disk declares its Proxmox interface slot (e.g., scsi0). Disk sizes can only be increased. Changing the interface field of an existing disk moves the disk to the new slot within the same bus family (e.g., scsi0 → scsi1 is allowed; scsi0 → sata0 is rejected at preview). When migrating from an older provider version (list-style disks), disks are assigned deterministic names disk-1, disk-2, etc. during state migration.

efidisk.description: EFI disk configuration (required when bios is set to ovmf).

hotplug.description: Comma-separated list of hotplug features (network, disk, cpu, memory, usb).

machine.description: Machine type for the VM (e.g., pc, q35, pc-i440fx-8.1).

node.description: Proxmox node where the VM resides.

ostype.description: Guest operating system type (e.g., l26, win11, other).

tags.description: Tags associated with the virtual machine.

template.description: Mark the VM as a template (1) or a regular VM (0).

vmId.description: Unique numeric identifier for the virtual machine (auto-assigned if omitted).
